targets.old: Territory is a serious word for a wet tunnel under Neverwinter, but if he maintains it, protects it, and has people who answer to him, then the word may be justified. Ownership and stewardship are not the same thing, of course. That distinction has caused considerable trouble everywhere from Mountain’s Toe Mine to the treasury of Phandalin.
targets.new: Territory is a serious word for a wet tunnel under Neverwinter. If he maintains it, protects it, and has people who answer to him, I need to know what that responsibility covers.

targets.old: This deserves clarification. A man who introduces a tunnel as his territory also accepts a degree of responsibility for its condition. Otherwise, it is not management. It is branding.
targets.new: I press him on the danger.
